svg.title: Five Core Seats, Seven at the Scaled Case
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-core-and-scaled-pod-seats; chart type: org_architecture; title: Five Core Seats, Seven at the Scaled Case; subtitle: Two full-time operators plus three contractors; add two seats selectively.; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Each numeric value represents one person, not one full-time equivalent. The first five seats form the Conservative and Base pod: 2 FT + 3 C. The final two seats expand the Scaled pod to 3 FT + 4 C. Contractor hours must be budgeted explicitly.; caption: Conservative: $250,000 × 5% = $12,500 owner net. Base: $1,125,000 × 11.5% = $129,375 owner net. Scaled: $2,000,000 × 18% = $360,000 owner net. Scale requires better unit economics, not automation alone.; stages: label: Core full-time seat: general manager and merchandising; value: Person 1: accountable for purchasing and profit; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own supplier authorization, pricing, purchase commitments, and weekly contribution review. Approve reorder quantities using lead times, cash availability, and inventory aging.; label: Core full-time seat: operations and customer experience; value: Person 2: accountable for fulfillment and exceptions; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own 3PL service levels, inventory discrepancies, shipment delays, and refund resolution. Escalate safety incidents and maintain a daily exception backlog with owners.; label: Core contractor seat: paid acquisition and creative; value: Person 3: bounded acquisition and campaign workload; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Report contribution by campaign after refunds and acquisition costs. Pause deteriorating cohorts and reuse approved product evidence when developing advertising claims.; label: Core contractor seat: automation and retention; value: Person 4: bounded integration and messaging workload; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain Shopify webhooks, 3PL routing, Klaviyo suppression, and return-status synchronization. Test retry behavior and duplicate-event handling before publishing workflow changes.; label: Core contractor seat: bookkeeping and inventory reconciliation; value: Person 5: bounded close and reconciliation workload; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile processor settlements, refunds, inventory assets, and supplier invoices. Prepare tax-provider handoffs and flag unexplained differences before the monthly close.; label: Scaled full-time addition: inventory and supply planning; value: Person 6: added only in the Scaled pod; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take ownership of purchasing forecasts, stock transfers, and supplier lead-time variability when these exceed the core manager's measured operating capacity.; label: Scaled contractor addition: customer-support overflow coverage; value: Person 7: added only in the Scaled pod; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Cover measured ticket peaks and returns administration under documented permissions. Keep refund authority, product-safety escalation, and customer-data access narrowly assigned.
